tasks.description: 1.1 Coordinator preserves existing work, creates the implementation branch from current development including50d6c30, and reconciles migration order, navigation and repository contracts; verify the recorded base/diff, new migration number and unchanged discussion tests before delegation.

1.2 Coordinator confirms feature-plan revision, design contracts, file ownership and scoped coverage files with implementers/tester; record fresh-context assignments and actual kickoff counters/time in the evidence record before coding starts.

2.1 Backend implementer owns report/mailbox types and repository adapters plus migration012; implement protected edit, severity revision/conflict, normalized no-op, idempotent receipt, immutable edit history and atomic assigned-Developer notification. Replace affected existing comment/workflow RPC definitions additively with locked source-project rechecks while preserving their contracts. Verify scoped repository tests and guarded isolated database scenarios in2.3; do not edit historical migrations or add lifecycle actions.

2.2 Backend implementer adds recipient-only mailbox list/mark-read/delete RPCs and repository pagination/error mapping. Verify private ownership, read persistence, replay safety and no report deletion with2.3.

2.3 Tester owns report-edit-repository.test.ts, report-edit-database.test.ts, mailbox-repository.test.ts and mailbox-database.test.ts under src/test/, plus minimal affected existing mocks. Map requirements to partitions/boundaries, test normalized limits, unauthorized/state/archive cases, severity ABA/explicit retry, no-op, receipt replay, rollback and project/assignment races. Add deterministic interleavings for project movement versus each existing comment/workflow mutation and source/destination archive fixtures, checking no stale-project authorization. Record deterministic runs separately from isolated database checks and explain any unavailable prerequisites.

2.4 Documentation writer updates docs/developerGuide/Reports.md and adds docs/developerGuide/Mailbox.md with migration, contracts, permissions, receipts/conflict semantics and verification setup; add its navigation/landing link and verify npm run docs:build against stabilized behavior.

2.5 Coordinator assigns every backend/test submission and any fixes a unique ID; reviewer explicitly approves those submissions or requests scoped fixes. Verify decisions and the reviewed plan revision before treating this group as accepted.

3.1 Frontend implementer owns report editor/page/form/detail history integration. Add original-Tester Edit report eligibility, prefilled edit mode, protected Save changes/Cancel, input-preserving severity notice/explicit retry and canonical success/no-op navigation. Verify report-edit-ui.test.ts and existing report/discussion regressions.

3.2 Frontend implementer reuses existing AI generation/edit/apply controls in edit mode without submission/draft methods, expanded context or changed limits; verify AI failure, explicit per-field application, stale suggestions and session/navigation cleanup in report-edit-ui.test.ts and affected report-suggestions-ui.test.ts.

3.3 Frontend implementer owns MailboxPage, ProjectsApp routes, AuthenticatedApp session wrappers and WorkspaceShell navigation. Implement approved cards, All/Unread, read/open/delete, pending/error/empty and account-stale protection; verify mailbox-ui.test.ts and existing route/auth tests.

3.4 Tester owns report-edit-ui.test.ts and mailbox-ui.test.ts and required existing UI/auth/suggestion test updates. Cover original versus other actors, four editable states, read-only states/archive races, unchanged save, retained text on conflicts/errors, explicit override, no accidental draft/submission, changed project continuity, mailbox privacy and asynchronous stale results. Provide the requirement/partition/boundary map and actual command results.

3.5 Documentation writer updates docs/userGuide/Reports.md and adds docs/userGuide/Mailbox.md describing actual editing, severity warning/override, AI reuse and mailbox actions; add navigation/landing links, reconcile mockup wording with implemented screens and verify npm run docs:build.

4.1 After functional files stabilize, coordinator transfers exclusive presentation ownership to ui_polisher. Inspect actual dark desktop/narrow and relevant loading/empty/validation/conflict/request-error states plus keyboard/focus; preserve whole-screen captures and a revision-linked visual-review.md. Verify findings/fixes with affected tests; no mockup is a rendered acceptance pass.

4.2 Tester runs feature-scoped coverage including every agreed production file with per-file80%lines/80%branches targets; preserve covered/total counts, uncovered paths and justified reviewer-accepted exceptions. Verify critical authorization/transaction/recovery scenarios separately even if numeric targets pass.

4.3 Coordinator records first-pass independent acceptance before repairs, actual user manual results when available, distinct defects/omissions versus new decisions, correction rounds and observed human effort. Collect all agent/retry/review usage with unknown resources labeled; verify evidence accuracy against commands/source/captures, without inventing savings.

4.4 Tester evaluates detection of a small declared set of local seeded defects in a disposable checkout if the required checks can safely execute; record exact mutations, detecting tests, restored clean diff and limits. If not run, record Not run without substituting test count or coverage as effectiveness evidence.

4.5 Coordinator runs the complete Vitest suite, lint, TypeScript/production build, docs build, strict OpenSpec validation and diff checks against the integrated feature. Verify guarded database scenarios and signed-in actual UI separately, retaining failed/skipped/unverified results and unresolved gates.

4.6 Reviewer explicitly decides every latest backend/frontend/tester/ui_polisher submission, fixes and the final combined implementation/tests/docs/visual evidence. Coordinator resolves findings, reruns affected checks and obtains fresh decisions after relevant changes; verify all approvals refer to final state.

4.7 After approval, backend/frontend implementers and tester write their separately owned template-based summaries in workflow/submitted-report-editing/. Coordinator checks function explanations, partition/boundary map, source/test links and actual evidence, then records a short retrospective and final log.

4.8 Coordinator prepares one PR targeting development and verifies the correct isolated preview database migration/environment and signed-in Vercel journeys when access is available; record exact preview revision, evidence and remaining limitations before merge consideration. Do not claim unavailable preview checks passed.

instruction:
Read context files, work through pending tasks, mark complete as you go.
Pause if you hit blockers or need clarification.
context:
Follow AGENTS.md and the relevant role definitions and instruction references it names.
The root agent coordinates delegated work using workflow/instructions/coordinator.md
and workflow/instructions/handoffs.md. Subagents do not spawn other agents.
Every implementer/tester/ui_polisher completion, including fixes, requires explicit independent
reviewer approval; affected later edits invalidate approval. Passing checks or task
checkboxes alone do not authorize overall task completion.
OpenSpec artifacts are authoritative for the selected change's requirements, design,
and tasks. Keep the required coordinator-owned workflow/<feature-name>/feature-plan.md
record, linking to exact artifact paths and revisions instead of conflicting copies.
Product proposals in BugWatch.md are not implementation authorization.
For feature discovery use workflow/instructions/exploration.md. Delegated assignments use
workflow/templates/agent-assignment-template.md without dropping mandatory context or review gates.
operationGuidance: Use the root agent as coordinator and read workflow/instructions/coordinator.md and workflow/instructions/handoffs.md before delegating; load specialist references required by AGENTS.md for the work assigned.

Read CLI-returned contextFiles and preserve its selected root, schema, blocked states, task sourcePath, and line information; refresh task locations before changing checkboxes if planning files changed.

In the coordinator-owned workflow record, link the resolved OpenSpec artifacts and agreed revisions for requirements, interfaces, tasks, and verification; record exclusive file ownership, submission identifiers, handoffs, findings, and approval decisions there.

Only the coordinator updates shared OpenSpec planning artifacts and tracked task checkboxes. Give each subagent exact artifact paths, revisions, task assignments, owned files, and expected handoff; report proposed contract changes to the coordinator and notify affected agents after an agreed update.

Once interfaces are ready, spawn implementer and tester before waiting for either when their work is independent. Tests derive expected outcomes from the specs and agreed contract; keep application and test edits in their assigned files and serialize shared-file changes.

After functional implementation stabilizes, assign ui_polisher a scoped visual pass for user-facing pages with exclusive presentation-file ownership. Collect every implementer/tester/ui_polisher completion as awaiting review, including fixes. Run applicable repository checks and obtain explicit reviewer decisions for each submission and the final combined work; rereview affected work after later edits, including coordinator fixes.

Mark each exact tracked task complete only after its specified work, required verification, and reviewer approval are satisfied. Keep blocked or unapproved work incomplete; never weaken tests, bypass CLI blockers, waive review, or treat all_done as evidence of approval.

Finalize required documentation against actual behaviour. After reviewer approval, obtain each participating implementer's and tester's template-based summary file in the feature directory, then record verification, current approvals, and summary checks in the workflow record and the single overall logs/ interaction log before reporting task completion.

Use the existing summary templates to explain function purpose, inputs/results, side effects, failure recovery and linked tests, and to map test partitions and boundaries to actual evidence. Assign workflow/instructions/ui-evidence.md for user-facing visual checks; preserve unverified limitations rather than substituting builds for rendered observations.

When an instruction-routing evaluation is part of the assigned scope, follow workflow/instructions/workflow-evaluation.md for fixed acceptance checks, matched controls, complete session accounting and uncertainty. Ordinary feature work does not automatically launch benchmark runs.
